Post Date: 2013-08-30T06:24:22Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Problem with parse and create
Description: I want to add a model to a collection and immediately trigger the 'add' event so that a view is instantly rendered.

However, I also want it to be persisted and saved as well.

I do not want to wait for save to return before add is triggered.

All of this should be fine, except that I have data in the model that needs to be created on parse.  An example is a url to a map whose value is dependent on the client's browser type.

If I call `collection.create(model)`, the model will be added to the collection, parsed, then saved.

The problem is that I want that parsing to be done, but I don't want that parsed data to be saved to the server.

I can fix this by doing `collection.create(model, {wait: true})`, but then there is a delay from when the model is created until the view is rendered.

Any ideas on this?  Essentially I want the data created in `parse` in the model to never be persisted to the server, just accessed locally.
